content.comment_body: I'm looking for a humidity sensor that can connect to my [product_name] [article_no]. Any recommendations?

Sure, there are plenty of options. Personally, I prefer the red one. If you are using a DC version of [product_name] ([product_name] [version_no]), you can utilize its analog input. Otherwise, you’ll need an analog extension unit ([product_name] [version_no] AM2) for your [product_name]. A sensor with a 0(2)–10 Volt output can be directly connected to the basic unit, while sensors with a 0(4)–20 mA output should be connected to the analog extension, or you can use a 500 Ohm resistor to connect it directly to the basic unit.
